checks.composition: pass: wide layered festival scene has a clear foreground, middle ground, and stage/background, with many varied colorful elements without obscuring the main idea.
checks.contact_perspective_physics: pass: figures stand on the ground and interact plausibly with stalls and objects; tables, stage, hanging lights, and perspective are consistent, with no major floating or intersection errors.
checks.meaning_recognition: pass: the richly colored, brightly lit night festival clearly conveys 五光十色 (brilliant, varied colors and dazzling light).

checks.people_hands_feet: pass: visible people have coherent poses and generally plausible hands, arms, legs, and feet; no distracting anatomical errors.
checks.style: pass: consistent child-friendly pencil/colored-pencil and soft watercolor illustration style with warm paper texture.
checks.text_brand_watermark: pass: no inappropriate readable text, branding, or watermark is visible.
